summary: engine.py (3100 lines) is split by layer in the order of knowledge/p11-refactor#extract: domain (stop.py Stop, item.py Item, report.py: answer parsers, report_problems, findings_problems, evidence_paths, continued, blocked, notes) -> infrastructure/files.py (write_json, read_json, runs_root, safe, run constants, new RunStore for run.json/state.json/options copy/agent numbers) + infrastructure/clock.py (the time seams) -> policies (allowance.py with pure over_target/batch_used/piece_count, routing.py, sandbox.py, retry_policy.py around retry.decide, risk.py, budget.py, skills.py) -> infrastructure/roles.py (role process, agent runs, argv/env, repair) + infrastructure/work_source.py (every orch.py source verb incl. register and commit taken out of finish) -> stages (scout, research, context, execute, checks_stage, review, triage, advice, close, finish) -> application (run_service.py: run/resume/retry/release/settle; loop.py: loop, pieces, claim, conduct, step, resolve). engine.py (305 lines) is a facade: Conductor keeps the run and binds the layer functions as its methods under the old names, so self-calls, Conductor.__new__ tests and mock.patch.object(Conductor, ...) work unchanged; public names are re-exported (__all__). The only classes are Conductor and RunStore. prompts.py (711) moved its answer parsers to domain/report.py, budgets to policies/budget.py and skill checks to policies/skills.py, re-exporting them (580). Behaviour unchanged: after every layer, characterization plus all test_conductor*/test_contracts*/test_conformance files (bash scripts/test.sh -p 'test_c[oh]*.py', 545 tests) passed; also test_gates, test_native_conformance, test_risk, test_boundaries, test_adhoc, ecosystem-units check and conduct.py --help.
